* Definition of confidential information
* Scope of the agreement, which outlines the types of information that are covered by the agreement
* Duration of the agreement, which specifies how long the agreement remains in effect
* Exceptions to the agreement, which outlines situations in which the receiving party is allowed to share the confidential information with others
